query:
SELECT u.email, u.id as user_id, u.created_at as registered,
       ua.id as action_id, ua.action_type, ua.created_at as action_date, ua.tokens_used, ua.status, ua.metadata
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN user_actions ua ON ua.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.email = 'ladaatn@gmail.com'
ORDER BY ua.created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
